description: I’m excited to announce that I am running for reelection as your State Representative for Norfolk’s 13th District. Serving our communities has been one of the greatest honors of my life. Together, we’ve made meaningful progress supporting our local schools, improving infrastructure, and advancing initiatives that make our neighborhoods safer, healthier, and stronger.
